event.text: You can manage this at home for now with over-the-counter itch relief; ask a pharmacist what suits you. Rash after poison ivy contact often appears to spread within the exposed area over a few days. Contact a clinician the same day if any of these appear: pus draining from a blister; spreading redness, warmth or increasing pain; fever; rash beyond your forearms; or involvement of your face, eyes or genitals. If same-day contact isn't available for those, use an urgent care clinic. If you develop trouble breathing, throat tightness, or rapidly progressive swelling affecting your mouth or throat, call 911.
